Bot: This is incredible…
It really does make an impression. 
A universe so vast it could be considered endless…
You: Didn’t know that the cosmos is this pretty and colorful.
Bot: It isn’t.
You: What?
Bot: This presentation uses fake colors. 
You: I didn’t know that. Isn’t this a scam then?
Bot: Fake colors are helping to show things that are unseeable for the human eye. It’s a standard in space photography. After all, human eyes can only process a sliver of the whole electromagnetic spectrum.
Bot: Besides, it’s much prettier this way.
You: I can’t argue with that.
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.veryshock
???: Shhh! {{punch}}
One of the teachers shushed me while giving a stern look.
I guess we will finish the show in silence…
